peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (64.1): 3.5 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 257 of 405 similar developments with a figure (the same as 5). Initial resale-wave effect: 0 of the 5 resales in Oct 2024–Sep 2026 came in the first 12 months of the resale wave (Oct 2024–Mar 2025); the sustained rate is shown separately. The wave start is based on the analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date. Context, not scored: resales in 20.8% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: 4.6 resales per 100 homes a year over 18 months (Apr 2025–Sep 2026): higher than 318 of 388 similar developments. First resale wave from Apr 2024 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date); 1 earlier resale does not start the wave. Observed 24-month activity: 3.5.

wave.basisLabel: analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Newton MRT about 470 m, Somerset MRT about 830 m; closer than 225 of 551 similar developments (the same as 10). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 7 within 2 km; nearest Anglo-Chinese School (Junior) about 210 m; more than 310 of 551 similar developments (the same as 182). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 7 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 620 m), more than 275 of 551 similar developments (the same as 68); nearest hawker centre Newton Food Centre about 420 m; nearest park Mount Emily Park about 860 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Sanctuary@Newton, 16 new sales, about 910 m; Orchard Sophia, 13 new sales, about 930 m; 32 Gilstead, 3 new sales, about 1,040 m; Duet @ Emily, 3 new sales, about 1,170 m; The Collective at One Sophia, 16 new sales, about 1,300 m; 21 Anderson, 6 new sales, about 1,370 m; Hill House, 5 new sales, about 1,420 m; Piccadilly Grand, 1 new sales, about 1,440 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 500 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 735 new sales and 1,361 resales (2,096 purchases); new sales were 35.1% of these purchases. Subsales (60) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,361 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 529 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,361 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,468 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−7.3%). Planning-area private resales +16%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
